audit.why: 48.96% over 674 games with EVEN 5.5/10 is fair: you own every stage except her level 6 Moonfall window, which the packet levelChart also gives to Diana.

audit.whatIsWrong: phases[4] gave level 6 to 'Skill' with a why describing YOUR Petrifying Gaze spike, while content win[4] and the packet both give level 6 to Diana.
audit.why: Moonfall (100s rank 1) plus Lunar Rush is her sharpest all-in, and it lands before your 120-second R matters. The row and its sentence disagreed with the other layer.
audit.corrected: phases[4].side -> Diana with a why that says why she wins it.

audit.whatIsWrong: The decisive interactions were never stated: Lunar Rush has NO cooldown onto a Moonlight-marked target, Miasma's grounding is the only thing that stops it, Pale Cascade's shield eats your opener, and Petrifying Gaze only stuns enemies facing you.
audit.why: Enemy E text: 'Lunar Rush has no cooldown when used to dash to an enemy afflicted with Moonlight.' Enemy W is flagged shield. Your R text stuns only enemies facing you.
audit.corrected: Ground the dash, force Pale Cascade out first, and turn into Moonfall so the R stuns rather than slows.

audit.whatIsWrong: breakdown.cooldowns had no digit (lint), and dosFull[2].d called Crescent Strike a 'fifteen-second' cooldown.
audit.why: Crescent Strike is 8/7.5/7/6.5/6, Lunar Rush 22/20/18/16/14, Pale Cascade 15/13.5/12/10.5/9, Moonfall 100/90/80. Fifteen seconds was invented.
audit.corrected: Real numbers written in; the invented cooldown replaced with 8s at rank 1.

audit.whatIsWrong: Ten fields called Diana 'he/his/him' (lint MISGENDER), dosFull[1].d was tradeGood verbatim and dontsFull[2].d was tradeBad verbatim (COPY_PASTE_BLEED), and dontsFull[0].d/dontsFull[1].d explained something other than their titles.
audit.why: champ-gender.js lists diana as female; the templates were written for a male enemy.
audit.corrected: Pronouns corrected and every bled body rewritten to its own title.

edits.before: - Diana Crescent Strike: matchup-defining — Moonlight marks reset her dash — sidestep the arc and her dive has no follow-up. Step up only on its downtime. - Budget R Petrifying Gaze for emergencies and the R for opportunities — never swap them.
